description: This file is a Java interface defining the contract for service operations related to product attributes within the sales manager core business layer. It declares methods for saving or updating product attributes and retrieving them based on different criteria such as option ID, value ID, product, or attribute IDs.

classes.name: ProductAttributeService
classes.description: Interface for product attribute related operations, extending generic entity service and including methods to save, update, and fetch product attributes based on various criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductAttribute entity, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes filtered by a specific option ID within a given merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes filtered by a specific option value ID within a given merchant store.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Fetches product attributes associated with a particular product in a specific store and language context.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves product attributes based on a list of attribute IDs within a merchant store.
